name: Ring of Muddled Thoughts
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 3rd; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of clear thought. Upon wearing the ring, the wearer has difficulty focusing his thoughts, imparting a -2 penalty to concentration checks. This penalty becomes -5 if the wearer attempts to cast defensively.

This ring can only be removed by the casting of remove curse upon it. Doing so destroys the ring.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of clear thought

Identification DC 28
False Identification DC 18
